description: OpenVPN Config Audit — Offline security audit of an OpenVPN 2.x server.conf or client .ovpn (role auto-detected; role= server|client to force). Flags cipher none and SWEET32 ciphers (BF/DES/CAST in cipher, data-ciphers or fallback), auth none/MD5, missing tls-version-min, no tls-crypt/tls-auth, compression (VORACLE, incl. pushed comp-lzo), management interface exposed or without password, static-key mode, DH 1024, script-security 3 and via-env, server running as root, duplicate-cn, client certs not required, no crl-verify, client-to-client, client without remote-cert-tls (MITM), auth-nocache, IPv6 leaks and deprecated directives (ns-cert-type, tls-remote, ncp-disable, comp-lzo). Inline <key>/<tls-crypt> blocks are never echoed. Returns PASS/REVIEW/FIX BEFORE DEPLOY/BLOCK, score, grade, findings with fixes, parsed settings and a hardened example. Pass the file in text=. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

port 1194
proto udp
dev tun
server 10.8.0.0 255.255.255.0
